query: 首席独立董事 首席独立董事 衡量企业是否设立首席独立董事（或资深独立董事）职位的制度化程度及其实际发挥的监督作用。重点考察其授权范围、召集权、对董事长的制衡能力及履职透明度。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越/高分）：设有首席独立董事；具备明确的职权清单（如：在董事长缺席或回避时主持会议、批准董事会会议日程）；拥有独立召集权（可定期在无内部董事参与的情况下召集独董会议）；并详细披露了年度履职报告或具体贡献。 • 1分（合格/中低分）：名义上设立了首席独立董事或类似职位，但在公司章程或治理报告中缺乏具体的职权边界说明，且未见其独立行使召集权或监督权的实质记录。 • 0分（不合格）：未设立首席独立董事，或在董事长与 CEO 合一的情况下未建立任何抵消性的独立治理机制。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：首席独立董事的职权已正式写入《公司章程》或《董事会议事规则》，且覆盖集团所有核心治理决策环节。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：仅在个别委员会（如审计委）中发挥牵头作用，或仅作为临时性安排，未形成制度化的长效机制。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关制度覆盖。 首席独立董事 资深独立董事 首席独立非执行董事 独董召集人 召集独董会议 纯独董会议 批准董事会议程 制衡董事长 股东沟通联系人 履职报告 SID LID Lead Independent Director Senior Independent Director Lead Independent Non-Executive Director LID SID convene independent directors independent directors-only meeting executive session board agenda approval checks on the chair shareholder liaison 是否设立首席独立董事、资深独立董事或实质等同职位？ 职权是否包括主持会议、批准或建议议程？ 可否在无执行董事或管理层参与下召集独董会议？ 是否作为股东与董事会沟通联系人并制衡董事长？ 是否披露年度履职？ 职权是否写入章程、议事规则或治理文件？

results.section: 舉報機制 / Whistle-blowing Mechanism
results.text: In order to enhance the employees' consciousness on the Group's internal justice, the Group has established a whistleblowing mechanism as an internal control to provide employees and stakeholders with reporting channels and guidelines. We also welcome internal and external stakeholders to raise their concerns about any suspected misconduct, fraud and inappropriate, unethical or unfair treatment in the supply chain, as well as notifying their department heads or reporting to the Chief Executive Officer; the Group handles all disclosed information in a confidential and cautious manner, including the identities of the informants. Once we acknowledge the receipt of the report, we would conduct further investigations accordingly. We would not tolerate any violation of laws or regulatory requirements and would refer any case we discover to local regulatory agencies such as the Hong Kong Police Force, Hong Kong Independent Commission Against Corruption, Securities and Futures Commission or relevant institutions in Mainland once discovered.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
舉報機制 / Whistle-blowing Mechanism

[Content]
In order to enhance the employees' consciousness on the Group's internal justice, the Group has established a whistleblowing mechanism as an internal control to provide employees and stakeholders with reporting channels and guidelines. We also welcome internal and external stakeholders to raise their concerns about any suspected misconduct, fraud and inappropriate, unethical or unfair treatment in the supply chain, as well as notifying their department heads or reporting to the Chief Executive Officer; the Group handles all disclosed information in a confidential and cautious manner, including the identities of the informants. Once we acknowledge the receipt of the report, we would conduct further investigations accordingly. We would not tolerate any violation of laws or regulatory requirements and would refer any case we discover to local regulatory agencies such as the Hong Kong Police Force, Hong Kong Independent Commission Against Corruption, Securities and Futures Commission or relevant institutions in Mainland once discovered.

results.text: Under the supervision of the Group's management offices, we are committed to high standards of accountability and transparency. We conduct quality inspection on our suppliers' products from time to time to ensure the quality of our products is up to standard. If a supplier is involved in three identical quality issues, its qualification to supply the affected products will be revoked. For raw materials with high risks in quality, we hold exchange meetings with suppliers from time to time, aiming to strengthen the promotion of supplier management and enhance the quality and service awareness of suppliers.

供應商遴選制度 / Supplier Selection System

[Content]
Under the supervision of the Group's management offices, we are committed to high standards of accountability and transparency. We conduct quality inspection on our suppliers' products from time to time to ensure the quality of our products is up to standard. If a supplier is involved in three identical quality issues, its qualification to supply the affected products will be revoked. For raw materials with high risks in quality, we hold exchange meetings with suppliers from time to time, aiming to strengthen the promotion of supplier management and enhance the quality and service awareness of suppliers.
